name: chalkroom-live
description: Chalkroom Live: a live classroom taught by an AI tutor on a shared whiteboard, for up to five learners.
author: GeoSafety

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @chalk/api" "npm run dev -w @chalk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chalk/web && npm run build -w @chalk/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.json
